reels.message: This reel's published mono and braid ratings give very different estimates using ReelCalc's reference diameters. The diameters behind the reel ratings may differ, so this does not prove a misprint. Treat capacity, backing amounts, and any shown ranges with extra caution. Check your spool's markings and stop at the recommended fill level, even if line remains.
